visual_description: A modern open‑plan office bathed in soft natural light from large windows. In the foreground, a mid‑30s corporate manager in a crisp white shirt and dark trousers sits at a sleek glass‑top conference table, leaning slightly forward with a furrowed brow. He is holding a thick multi‑page contract in his left hand; a bright red sticky note is affixed near the middle of the pages, the edge of the note jutting out to draw attention. In his right hand he rests a black ball‑point pen, the tip poised over a highlighted paragraph. Across the table, a colleague—dressed in business‑casual attire—points with an open hand toward the contract, his expression serious and inquisitive, as if questioning whether the clause is merely routine or potentially illicit. Between them, a thin laptop is open; the screen shows a generic spreadsheet with a red upward‑pointing arrow and a small amber warning triangle in the corner, indicating a flagged transaction without any visible text or numbers. Scattered on the table are a half‑filled coffee mug, a closed folder labeled only by its shape, and a small stack of paper‑clips. The background shows rows of desks with computers, a few potted plants, and a muted wall with abstract art, keeping the focus on the interaction at the table. The camera is positioned at a slight high angle, looking down over the manager’s shoulder to capture both the contract with the red note and the colleague’s gesturing hand, while still showing the manager’s concerned face. Lighting is even, with daylight streaming from the windows creating gentle shadows and highlighting the red elements (sticky note, pen tip, warning arrow) to emphasize the legal‑risk moment. MANDATORY VISUAL REGENERATION NOTES: A modern open-plan office, high-angle view. A professional corporate manager in a white shirt sits at a sleek glass conference table, holding a thick contract with a bright red sticky note protruding from it. A colleague sits across the table gesturing toward the document with a serious, inquisitive expression. A laptop sits between them showing a spreadsheet with a clear amber warning triangle icon on the screen. Professional, realistic corporate photography, sharp focus, well-lit, no distracting text. Avoid people and hands when possible. Prefer a clean, realistic scene with objects/documents only.
